chunks: I call to witness the Qur'an, custodian of all laws,

key_terms.الْحَكِيمِ: The Wise, possessing perfect wisdom and authority

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by being called 'Al-Hakim' (The Wise)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath underscores the Qur'an's intrinsic wisdom (Hikmah), distinguishing it as a complete and self-sufficient source of guidance that requires no external validation. The term 'Hakim' is often interpreted to signify that the Qur'an is free from defects and contains the profound secrets of divine law, reinforcing its authority alongside the Ahl al-Bayt as the twin sources of guidance.
